value.name: Columbia need-based grant aid (Columbia College / Columbia Engineering)

scholarship_exists.quote: Loans are not a component of financial aid packages. Our need-based aid is in the form of grants and work-study positions.
scholarship_exists.notes: Need-based, no loans; meets 100% of demonstrated need for admitted first-years. Not need-blind for international/non-domestic applicants.

scholarship_international.quote: Columbia meets 100% of the demonstrated financial need for all students admitted as first-years and transfers, including international / non-domestic students.
scholarship_international.notes: Admission is need-aware for international applicants ("Columbia is not need-blind for international/non-domestic students").
